subject: MAGNET status: benchmarks reproduced, cache invalidation bite
body:
Hi Daniela, Dmitri,

Status for the Apr 24 milestone - we'll make it, with one caveat.

Benchmark suite is reproduced on both regional catalogs. MAGNET beats the strongest statistical benchmark on mean log-likelihood on both, consistent with the paper's finding, and Ondrej's examine-results notebooks now render the comparison automatically from the cached_benchmarks directory.

The caveat: we hit a nasty cache-invalidation issue. Cached features computed before Paloma's ingestion fix (Mar 30) silently mixed catalog revisions - training read stale features while benchmarks used fresh ones, which cost us about a week of confusing eval deltas. Fix is in: cache keys now include the catalog revision hash, and stale entries fail loudly instead of loading.

Remaining risk for June: full-catalog feature computation is ~9 days of CPU time. We've started it early in chunks so everything is cached well before the training sweep. teh schedule holds.

Tereza
